rationale: C22 is an unmistakable material drafting template for the child. The child expressly cites the March 31, 1961 directive and repeats nearly its entire structure and language: the same amended statutory recitals, immediate-publication provision, import/marketing authority, zero-quota finding, operative zero-quota determination, continued delegation to the Secretary of Agriculture with State concurrence, and immediate-effective-date clause. The principal substantive adaptation is the quota period, changed from calendar year 1961 to the six-month period ending June 30, 1962. C09 is a very close earlier version of the same template, while C01 supplies an earlier form of the same statutory machinery but differs more materially in its recitals and quota determination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 408(b) (1) of the Sugar Act of 1948, as amended by the act of March 31, 1961, provides that the President shall determine ... the quota for Cuba for the period ending June 30, 1962
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 408(b) (1) of the Sugar Act of 1948, as amended by the act of March 31, 1961, provides that the President shall determine ... the quota for Cuba for the period ending June 30, 1962
shared_material.explanation: The opening statutory recital is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I find it to be in the national interest that the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... for the six-month period ending June 30, 1962, should be zero
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I find it to be in the national interest that the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... for the calendar year 1961 should be zero
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same finding and substitutes only the applicable quota period.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Do hereby determine that in the national interest the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... shall be zero
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Do hereby determine that in the national interest the amount of the quotas for sugar and for liquid sugar for Cuba ... shall be zero
shared_material.explanation: The core operative determination is repeated nearly verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Do hereby continue the delegation to the Secretary of Agriculture ... such authority to be continued to be exercised with the concurrence of the Secretary of State.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Do hereby continue the delegation to the Secretary of Agriculture ... such authority to be continued to be exercised with the concurrence of the Secretary of State.
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive interagency delegation mechanism is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This proclamation shall become effective immediately upon publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This proclamation shall become effective immediately upon publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: The same effectiveness clause completes the parallel operative sequence.
